objective.text: Check batch cancellation in a long-running or queued job rather than assuming all jobs stop immediately.

difficulty.rationale: Make cancellation affect actual job behavior instead of treating a metadata flag as a process kill.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A user cancels a batch while some jobs are waiting and another is doing a long loop. Which implementation makes the cancellation meaningful for the work itself?

options.text: Assume cancel() deletes every queued payload from every supported backend.
options.rationale: The metadata operation does not guarantee physical removal of all already queued jobs.
options.misconception: The metadata operation does not guarantee physical removal of all already queued jobs.

options.text: Clear the batch name so workers cannot locate their work anymore.
options.rationale: The batch’s identifier and cancellation state govern its metadata; renaming is not a stop protocol.
options.misconception: The batch’s identifier and cancellation state govern its metadata; renaming is not a stop protocol.

options.text: Rely on cancel() to terminate every active PHP worker immediately.
options.rationale: Batch cancellation is not an operating-system process-kill mechanism.
options.misconception: Batch cancellation is not an operating-system process-kill mechanism.

options.text: Check batch cancellation before work and at safe loop checkpoints, or use cancellation middleware for the entry check.
options.rationale: Cancellation records state; handlers need cooperative checks to avoid or stop work at safe boundaries.

explanation.summary: Cancellation records state; handlers need cooperative checks to avoid or stop work at safe boundaries.
